operations.append: External-credential evidence — FEAT327-ACQ-04. NEW evidence-contract completion; the four existing feat procedures and their prerequisite alternatives are retained. For frenzied_rage, divine_favor, elemental_body and dragon_blood, evaluate a required external credential under ACQ04-EC1 against the same character, world and ordered acquisition snapshot, using the exact operative prerequisite and source version, linked credential or event evidence, and that world's established authority for recording that fact. A source file establishes wording, not that a particular character acquired a feature, worships a deity, experienced an event or possesses a lineage. A name, nonempty story label, unchecked Boolean, prospective feat benefit or unrelated class/ancestry/item grant supplies no credential. The supporting grant, worship state or exposure event must already qualify before acquisition; same-time events require an authoritative earlier sequence. Worship must be established at that snapshot; exposure is a qualifying prior event, not a requirement to remain exposed. Apply the branch-specific facts and required choices in ACQ04-EC1 without adding doctrine, an exposure threshold, an element-to-plane matching rule or a legacy alias. A conditional, opaque test-world fixture can establish only a CONDITIONAL_ONLY predicate result within that fixture. It supplies no actual campaign history, selectable option, class feature, cosmology approval or entitlement. Missing, unbound, mismatched or insufficient evidence leaves a predicate UNESTABLISHED; affirmative incompatible evidence is CONTRADICTED. Neither result satisfies a required AND node, although a separately satisfied printed OR alternative remains valid. An ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT result requires independently admitted actual-world evidence and is not supplied by this review. Preserve all original source fields, absence/null distinctions, acquisition history and current status/selection flags. All other permanent-ability, level, parent-feat, mandatory-choice and earned-opportunity predicates remain independently required; one paid opportunity cannot fund two acquisitions. Later use still requires the exact feat's ongoing predicates. This evidence policy does not reopen ACQ-03 or change its casting-snapshot rules.
